$comment: Read by scripts/brand-lint.mjs; see its header. Every allow, exact and accepted entry needs a reason. Baseline entries are known leaks with an owner: they warn and do not fail, and are deleted once fixed.

scopes.name: ui
scopes.description: Strings and text in the desktop app (web UI, Tauri shell and config), the mobile app, the full-screen terminal UI and the shared client

scopes.name: commands
scopes.description: Slash-command names, summaries, help and reports

scopes.name: cli-help
scopes.description: `neuron --help`, argument errors and the line REPL's messages

scopes.name: prompt
scopes.description: The system prompt every model receives

scopes.name: identity
scopes.description: How requests identify themselves: app name and beta headers. Model IDs and the provider's protocol names are fine here

scopes.name: engine
scopes.description: The rest of the engine's messages (status, plugin warnings, provider names, reports). Report only until WP1 sorts its leaks from its compatibility names; then drop `report`

allow.reason: Model IDs exactly as a provider's catalog returns them (claude-sonnet-4-6, anthropic/claude-…, us.anthropic.claude-…). Display names such as "Claude Opus 4.6" are not IDs and still fail.
Compatibility instruction files that Neuron reads (guardrail 2). Neuron's own file is NEURON.md.
Compatibility directories that Neuron reads (.claude/skills, ~/.claude, .claude-plugin). Neuron's own directory is .neuron/.
Environment variables of the provider's own SDK (ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL) that Neuron reads for bring-your-own-key use.
Compatibility config location that Neuron reads skills and commands from.
Internal crate, binary and variable names. Not user-facing; renamed before any public source release (P2, guardrail 2).
A third-party plugin namespace whose commands Neuron recognizes for compatibility.
The provider's protocol header names and API host, for the Anthropic bring-your-own-key provider.

exact.reason: The provider ID for bring-your-own-key use (--provider anthropic), as a whole literal.

baseline.reason: found by brand-lint, not in the plan's T6 list: the dump-manifests hint names the reference product's variable; rename it (keep the old name as an alias) or accept it here
